notes.title: MP Beta Release along with new content
notes.notes:
Hey all,

TOG2 multi is now fully accessible on beta branch for full scale testing
- 4 Players COOP Maps (either battles or breaching)
- One 16 Players BR maps

This release also contains previous beta updates :
- new maps
- new weapons to unlock
- Improvements in the infiltration engine 
- lot of bug corrections

Next update will be dedicated to finishing MP and make the story mode linking everything

Hope you'll enjoy it

Jay

notes.title: TOG2 Update - New breach map & improved weapon picking
notes.notes:
Hey all,

TOG 2 has been updated with :

- New breach Map : Washington
- Doors to breach showed on tablet minimap for all breach maps
- Tablet improved to display only usefull information depending on Game Mode & Ratio (no position of ITF or Squad in lone wolf, etc)
- Breach maps global mechanics improved (disputed zones, time for enemies to spawn, etc)
- All melee weapons in infil maps can be grabbed now (bug corrected)

- Improved weapon slots colliders. They will keep their position whatever your stance (Standing, knee down, etc) so you will always be able to grab things at the same place

notes.title: TOG2 - Beta update - Vehicules incoming....
notes.notes:
TOG2 beta updated with :
- First piece of vehicule framework with a working Dune buggy available in Syria 
use left controller button A when close to go in/out
use left controller stick/pad up or down to accelerate/brake
grab the steering wheel with left and/or right hand to steer the vehicule
vehicule is semi full physic (collision with your hands /weapons but not body). you can run over enemies but will only make your teamates move away
if buggy is upside/down after a crash, you can flip it over by pushing it with your hands

- Some zip lines added to Syria for testing
- bug corrections

[previewyoutube=iH8Je7AmEO0;full][/previewyoutube]

Improved equipement slots system for better grabing :
Slots are now in fixed position relative to chest so position won't change whatever the stance you're in (standing, crouching, one knee down)

notes.title: Tales Of Glory 2 - Big update
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Main branch has been updated with the following features :

[b]New game mode : Breach - Squad only battles with door breaching and hostage situation[/b]
New York Map 1 (city) & 2 (indoor cqb)
Dedicated squad orders to breach in (point a door with tactical zone pointer)
regroup / check lock / breach a door (explosive / open & bang / door kick, etc)
Fully random hostage model
Full door physics (shoot the lock to open, open with hands, kick the door open, etc)

 
[b]New battle Map : Kazakhstan[/b]

[b]Full native bHaptics integration :[/b]
- Vest
- Tactal (Face haptics)
- Tactosy (Arms haptis)

[b]Small features :[/b]
- New crouched position for easy grabbing
- Improved eye relief on magnifier & acog
- Corrected balcony in guyana uncharted village
- Corrected LOD issue on Rocks in Guyana (other side of sattelite dish bridge)
- Corrected fence in Mogdishu infiltration
- Better physical handling
- Cutting hand physics when tracking is lost
- Suppressor on Ruger precision rifle
- Bullet trail for player weapon
- Flashbang visual effect modified depending on where you look
- Steyr Aug to unlock in Assault cat
- Nasty bug corrected on enemies targeting Squad members. 
- Improved Index Knuckles grab 
- Slow health Regen for squad members
- Improved Voice Recognition orders

Cheers,

Jay

notes.title: Big update
notes.notes:
Hey all,

following the feedback on Discord & Steam hub, i'm pushing the actual beta to main with the following features :

- Second hand position fixed 
- Shotgun available for ITF soldiers
- Taiwan infiltration start bug 
- Make grenades not visible when empty 
- Make NPC reload their weapon before mag is empty and in cover 
- Magazine issue on dual weapon 
- 10X Scope added on G3 
- Scope performance review 1st step 


- Switch buttons for Mag release / FiringMode  for 2  buttons controllers only (Done)
--> Button 1 = Firing Mode
--> Button 2 = Mag release
--> Stick up = Jump
--> Stick down = Kick

Vive wands & WMR users stays with the previous config (need to enable One button mode on main menu)

- additionnal scope perf upgrade
- rotation of handguns issue when second hand is mounted corrected
- new weapon sounds
- XP not saving fixed
- Taiwan RPG removed 
- Toggle grip on second second hand fixed
- Syria pathfinding issue 
- Haptic feedback for knife & punch & headsmash & buttstock hit 
- Change NPC Sniper AI to use more Height cover
- Remove Pin on grenades thrown by npcs  & spoon too
- Make npcs throw bangs
- Changed Taiwan Quantum/ITF ratio
- Prevent Npc from firing through walls sometimes (Done but will need feedback)

- Grenades / bangs / Smoke reworked with cooking.  Need to press & maintain trigger on hand holding the grenade to unpin. If trigger is released after unpinning, you'll let go the spoon. <-- i suggest you try the new mechanic in Lobby :laughing: 

- Bipod issue corrected
- Color Dots on sights for all handguns
- Some Taiwan pathfinding issue corrected
- Squad orders not working sometimes bug fixed
- Natalya bugged when healing corrected
- Added heal percentage on down teamate
- Natalya/Zaak moving directly to you when calling Heal/Ammo even if you move to another place
- Avatar blocked on small obstacle fixed : you'll be able to go over obstacles up to 40cm without jumping
- Loadout issue fixed
- Russia occlusion bug fixed
- Lot of work on Taiwan/Guyana (breakable windows, vegetation issue, some lod issues, etc)
- Corrected gaze locomotion

Cheers

Jay
